name: Whimbrel
tagline: The private AI assistant that remembers your work
description: Whimbrel is a desktop AI assistant for Mac and Windows that records meetings without a bot, remembers what you worked on, and turns it into briefings, answers, and follow-ups.

requirements.mac: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon (M1 or newer)

demoVideo.title: Whimbrel product tour
demoVideo.description: A one-minute walkthrough of Whimbrel with Wi-Fi off: a meeting recorded without a bot and transcribed on the computer, its summary, a page for the client, and a cited answer from a local model.
